simple.meaning: properly, set upright ; hence (figuratively as adjective) just ; but usually (as adverb or conjunction) rightly or so (in various applications to manner, time and relation; often with other particles)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to כֵּן (H3651) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: adv.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 771 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: כֵּן (kên) means properly, set upright ; hence (figuratively as adjective) just ; but usually (as adverb or conjunction) rightly or so (in various applications to manner, time and relation; often with other particles) First listed occurrence: 1Chr 11 7.
